findings: Seed100 reaches valid geometric insertion. Raw reported linear/angular velocities veto all sampled final stable-frame scores despite micrometre-scale pose motion at external physics-step resolution. No retroactive success conversion.

PhysX documentation explicitly distinguishes reported velocities from pose integration under constraints. This supports the explanation of the observed discrepancy; the exact installed internal solver mechanism/version is not measured by the archive.

The4mm-overdrive holding change lowers finger force from roughly26/29N to roughly5N and permits43-51degree in-hand rotation during lift. Bilateral contact remains true and the25mm attachment proxy cannot guarantee a fixed grasp transform.

Seed101 continues changing grasp transform after post-lift calibration. TCP transverse errors converge while object-target alignment fails before contact; nominal forward motion then reaches a front-face jam.

Seed100 recovery completes backout/realign/reinsert and aborts at40 verify actions. Seed101 completes backout only and aborts at120 realign actions with near-zero transverse TCP error but unacceptable object alignment. Additional wait/actions do not repair stale grasp geometry in this record.
